translations.Kein Lesezugriff auf die Vereinsbuchhalt: No read access to the club accounting.

translations.Womit möchtest du starten? Das lässt sic: What would you like to start with? You can change this later at any time.
translations.Kontenrahmen und bisherige Buchungen per: Import the chart of accounts and existing entries via an .xbuc file.
translations.Erprobten Standard-Kontenrahmen anlegen: Create a proven standard chart of accounts and get started right away.
translations.Erst mit Beispieldaten ausprobieren: Try it out with sample data first
translations.Ein kleiner Beispielverein zum Kennenler: A small sample club to explore – reset it again with a single click later.
translations.Es ändert sich nur die Kontozuordnung di: Only the account assignment of this one side changes – amount, date, description, and the other side remain unchanged.
translations.Geldkonto mit Anfangsbestand eintragen: Enter opening balance for a cash/bank account
translations.Zahnrad → Berechtigungen: Nutzer/Gruppen: Gear icon → Permissions: assign users/groups as administrator, bookkeeper, or auditor.
translations.Tab Konten → „Standard-Kontenrahmen anle: Accounts tab → “Create standard chart of accounts” – or Settings → “Import from zero Buchhaltung” if you have existing data.
translations.Je Geldkonto (Bank/Kasse) einen Anfangsb: Enter an opening balance for each cash/bank account.
translations.Einstellungen → Belegablage und Verein:: Settings → Receipt storage and club: set the storage location for receipts and the club name.
translations.Kontoumsätze importieren: Tab Buchungen: Import bank transactions: Entries tab → upload the bank's CSV file (duplicates are detected automatically).
translations.Tab „Zuzuordnen\": jede offene Bankbuchu: “To assign” tab: every open bank transaction gets a contra account – suggestions and rules often do this automatically.
translations.Enthält ein Umsatz mehreres zugleich (Be: If a transaction covers more than one thing at once (membership fee and donation): “Split…” distributes it across several contra accounts.
translations.Manuelle Buchung: Button „+ Buchung\" –: Manual entry: the “+ Entry” button – in simple mode, income/expense, category, and cash/bank account are enough.
translations.Belege lassen sich direkt an jede Buchun: Receipts can be attached directly to any entry (photo or file).
translations.Jedes Konto hat eine Nummer, einen Namen: Every account has a number, a name, and a type (income, expense, asset, liability, equity).
translations.Das Flag „Bankkonto\" markiert Geldkonte: The “Bank account” flag marks cash/bank accounts – only these carry a balance forward across the year boundary.
translations.Konten lassen sich über- und unterordnen: Accounts can be nested (field “Parent account”) to form a tree structure.
translations.Bebuchte Konten lassen sich nicht lösche: Accounts with entries can't be deleted, but can be deactivated via the “Account active” switch – they disappear from selection lists while the history stays.
translations.Auf ein Konto klicken zeigt den Kontoaus: Clicking an account shows its statement with a running balance.
translations.Dashboard: Einnahmen/Ausgaben/Ergebnis d: Dashboard: income/expenses/result for the selected year with a year-over-year comparison.
translations.Saldenliste: alle Konten mit Soll, Haben: Trial balance: all accounts with debit, credit, and balance, optionally including sub-accounts.
translations.Kassenbericht (Berichte → Auswertung): d: Treasurer's report (Reports → Summary): a print-ready summary for the general meeting.
translations.Prüfleitfaden (Berichte → Auswertung): d: Audit guide (Reports → Summary): a print-ready quick guide for auditors.
translations.Kostenstellen, Sphären und Finanzplan: A: Cost centers, spheres, and budget: reporting by project, by tax category, or planned-vs-actual comparison.
translations.Vier steuerliche Sphären: ideeller Berei: Four tax spheres: non-profit purpose, asset management, purpose-related operation, commercial trading activity.
translations.Zuordnen im Konto-Dialog (Feld „Steuerli: Assign it in the account dialog (field “Tax sphere”), or for several accounts at once under Settings → “Tax spheres”.
translations.Tab Berichte → „Sphären\" zeigt Einnahme: Reports tab → “Spheres” shows income/expenses/result per sphere.
translations.Freigrenze wirtschaftlicher Geschäftsbet: Exemption threshold for commercial trading activity: currently €45,000 gross income/year – the dashboard warns with a traffic-light indicator as soon as there's income there. This does not replace tax advice.
translations.Die Spalte „Aktuell\" zeigt den heutigen: The “Current” column shows today's budget value, “Δ” the deviation of the current budget from the snapshot.
This snapshot contains no budget values.
translations.dürfen alles inkl. Rechtevergabe,: may do everything incl. assigning permissions,
translations.nur lesen. Nextcloud-Administratoren sin: read only. Nextcloud administrators are always administrators.
Please specify a user or group.
translations.Ordnet Einnahmen-/Ausgaben-Konten einer: Assigns income/expense accounts to a sphere (non-profit purpose, asset management, purpose-related operation, commercial trading activity) – important for tax-exempt status and the exemption threshold of the commercial trading activity. This does not replace tax advice.
translations.: Buchungen, Belege und Zuordnungen dies: : entries, receipts, and assignments for this year can no longer be changed or deleted – e.g. after the audit and discharge. Only administrators can close or reopen a year; both actions are recorded in the log (Reports → Log).
translations.Noch keine Geschäftsjahre mit Buchungen: No fiscal years with entries yet.
translations.Löscht alle Konten, Buchungen und Import: Irrevocably deletes all accounts, entries, and imports of this account.
translations.Das Geschäftsjahr {year} wird festgeschr: Fiscal year {year} will be locked: entries, receipts, and assignments for this year can no longer be changed afterwards. An administrator can reopen the year if needed.
translations.Das Geschäftsjahr {year} wird wieder änd: Fiscal year {year} will become editable again. This should only happen in exceptional cases (e.g. a correction before the audit) and is logged.
translations.Regeln ordnen offenen Bankbuchungen auto: Rules automatically assign a contra account to open bank transactions: if the selected field (payee, purpose, or IBAN) contains the search text, the contra account is suggested and set directly on import. If several rules match, the higher priority wins.
translations.Lege oben eine Regel an – oder erzeuge s: Create a rule above – or generate one directly from a bank transaction in the Entries tab.
translations.Kostenstellen bündeln Konten zu Projekte: Cost centers group accounts into projects, departments, or events – the report
translations.zeigt dann Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Ergeb: then shows income, expenses, and result per cost center. Cost centers created here are evaluated by the app as soon as the mode
translations.eingestellt. Die Zuordnung unten wird da: is set. The assignment below will then
translations.ausgewertet; die Namen der Kostenstellen: be evaluated; the cost center names still apply, though. This can be changed further below under
translations.Name: Name
translations.2. Zahlengruppe der Kontonummer: 2nd digit group of the account number
translations.jedes Konto eine eigene Kostenstelle: each account its own cost center
translations.Die Zuordnung von {count} Konto/Konten w: The assignment of {count} account(s) will be removed; entries remain unchanged.
translations.Erkannt werden CSV-CAMT, CAMT.053 (XML): CSV-CAMT, CAMT.053 (XML), and MT940 are recognized – the format is determined from the content, the file extension doesn't matter. Only new entries are imported; already imported ones are detected automatically (duplicate check).
translations.Davon {n} bereits als vorhandene Buchung: Of these, {n} were already recognized as existing entries (e.g. from an XBUC import) and therefore skipped.
translations.Alle Buchungen dieser Datei wurden berei: All entries in this file have already been imported.
translations.{n} Buchungen warten auf die Zuordnung z: {n} entries are waiting to be assigned to an account.
translations.Der Umsatz wird auf mehrere Gegenkonten: The transaction is split across several contra accounts – for a transfer that covers more than one thing at once (e.g. membership fee and donation). The cash/bank account stays unchanged.
translations.Den noch offenen Rest in die letzte Zeil: Write the remaining open amount into the last line
translations.Geldkonto (Bank/Kasse) – Bestand geht üb: Cash/bank account – balance carries across year boundaries
translations.Nur nötig, wenn die Buchhaltung mehrere: Only needed if the accounting has several cash/bank accounts: it lets the app assign imported bank statements to the right account. Spaces don't matter.
translations.Ein inaktives Konto verschwindet aus all: An inactive account disappears from all selection lists – already posted amounts, reports, and the history remain unchanged. This is how you get rid of accounts that can't be deleted because they already have entries.
translations.Vereinsname (erscheint im Kopf des Kasse: Club name (appears in the header of the treasurer's report)
translations.Logo und Akzentfarbe erscheinen im Kurzb: Logo and accent color appear in the short report for board meetings (Reports → Summary).
translations.Bestimmt, wie der Bericht „Kostenstellen: Determines how the “Cost centers” report groups accounts. The first two modes read the cost center from the chart of accounts and assume it was built for that. The third makes no such assumption: cost centers are created and accounts are explicitly assigned to them (see the “Cost centers” section above).
translations.2. Zahlengruppe der Kontonummer (z. B. „: 2nd digit group of the account number (e.g. “111 51” → cost center 51)
translations.Jedes Einnahmen-/Ausgabenkonto ist eine: Every income/expense account is its own cost center
translations.Frei definierte Kostenstellen (Konten we: Freely defined cost centers (accounts are assigned)
translations.Belege können intern (AppData, nicht in: Receipts can be stored internally (AppData, not visible in the Nextcloud interface) or in a folder of a Nextcloud user. If no user is selected, internal storage is used.
translations.Ordnerpfad im Nutzer-Home: Folder path in the user's home
translations.Legt man den im Onlinebanking herunterge: If you place the bank statement downloaded from online banking into this folder, the app reads it in automatically – no more manual uploading. CSV-CAMT, CAMT.053 (XML), and MT940 are recognized. Leave empty to disable the feature.
translations.die Nextcloud-Instanz muss Hintergrundau: the Nextcloud instance must run background jobs via system cron (Administration → Basic settings); with “AJAX” they only run while someone has Nextcloud open.
translations.Übernimmt Kontenbaum und alle Buchungen: Imports the account tree and all entries from an .xbuc file.
translations.{n} Buchung(en) ohne Gegenkonto werden a: {n} entry/entries without a contra account are imported as open bank transactions and appear in the Entries → To assign tab.
translations.Kein Geschäftsjahr in der Datei hinterle: No fiscal year stored in the file – enter a year to enable the date check.
translations.wird übernommen (keine Vorjahresbuchunge: will be imported (no prior-year entries present)
translations.wird übersprungen, stimmt mit dem Vorjah: will be skipped, matches the prior year's closing balance ✓
translations.wird übersprungen – ⚠ Vorjahres-Endstand: will be skipped – ⚠ prior year's closing balance is {prior} (difference {diff})
translations.⚠ {n} Buchung(en) liegen außerhalb des G: ⚠ {n} entry/entries fall outside fiscal year {year} and would be assigned to a different year in the app:

translations.Rückwärts-Import (früheres Jahr): Abglei: Backward import (earlier year): reconciling with the year transition to {year}.
translations.⛔ Import blockiert, bis die Beträge am J: ⛔ Import blocked until the amounts at the year transition match.
translations.{n} überflüssige Eröffnungsbuchung(en) a: {n} redundant opening entry/entries from {year} will be removed during import (the opening balance will then come from this earlier year).
translations.Achtung: bestehende Daten werden gelösch: Warning: existing data will be deleted.
translations.Alle vorhandenen Daten werden gelöscht u: All existing data will be deleted and replaced. Continue?

translations.Achtung: Anfangsbestand {account} laut D: Warning: opening balance {account} per file {fileAmount}, prior year's closing balance in the app {priorBalance} – please check the prior year's entries.
translations.– Freigrenze überschritten, bitte mit St: – exemption threshold exceeded, please clarify with a tax advisor.
translations.Importiere Kontoumsätze oder lege manuel: Import bank transactions or create journal entries manually.
translations.Inaktiv – taucht in keiner Auswahlliste: Inactive – no longer appears in any selection list
translations.Konto links auswählen, um Buchungen anzu: Select an account on the left to show its entries.

No entries on this account (incl. sub-accounts).
translations.🔒 Das Geschäftsjahr {year} ist abgeschlo: 🔒 Fiscal year {year} is closed – this entry can only be viewed.
translations.Wähle zuerst, ob Geld reinkommt oder rau: First choose whether money is coming in or going out – step 1 of 3.
translations.Wähle die Kategorie (z. B. „Mitgliedsbei: Choose the category (e.g. “membership fees”) and the cash/bank account – the app books debit/credit correctly automatically. Step 2 of 3.
translations.Ein kurzer Text erklärt später, worum es: A short text will later explain what it was about – done! Step 3 of 3.

translations.Druckfertiger Kassenbericht für die Mitg: Print-ready treasurer's report for the general meeting (opens in a new tab, print or save as PDF there)
translations.Kurzbericht: Bewegungen seit diesem Datu: Short report: activity since this date
translations.Kurzbericht für die nächste Vorstandssit: Short report for the next board meeting (opens in a new tab, print or save as PDF there)
translations.Alle Belege des Jahres als ZIP herunterl: Download all receipts of the year as ZIP (for the audit)
translations.Druckfertige 1-Seiten-Kurzanleitung für: Print-ready one-page quick guide for auditors (opens in a new tab)
translations.Mehrjahresübersicht (alle Jahre) als CSV: Export multi-year overview (all years) as CSV

translations.Keine Buchungen mit Betrag in dieser Sph: No entries with an amount in this sphere.
translations.Rücklagen sind Eigenkapital-Konten mit f: Reserves are equity accounts with a defined reserve type (§ 62 AO, German tax code). Allocations happen as a normal entry (expert mode in the entry dialog, equity-to-equity transfer) – here you only see the current balance per type.
translations.Noch keinem Konto eine Rücklagen-Art zug: No account has a reserve type assigned yet. Set it in the account dialog of an equity account (Accounts tab).
translations.Plane je Konto die erwarteten Einnahmen: Plan the expected income and expenses per account (“Plan” column). The “Actual” column shows the actual entries for the selected fiscal year, “Difference” the gap to the plan.
translations.Notiz zur Planzahl anzeigen: Show note on the plan figure
translations.Notiz zur Planzahl hinzufügen: Add note to the plan figure
translations.z.B. Beschluss MV: e.g. resolution of the general meeting
translations.Friere den aktuellen Finanzplan als bena: Freeze the current budget as a named, dated snapshot (e.g. the budget resolved at the general meeting). Later plan changes leave the snapshot unaffected.
translations.Noch keine Stände für dieses Jahr gespei: No snapshots saved for this year yet.
translations.Wer hat wann was geändert – z. B. für di: Who changed what and when – e.g. for the audit. The log is kept automatically and survives even a full data reset.
translations.Änderungen ab Version 0.10.41 werden hie: Changes from version 0.10.41 onward are recorded here.
translations.Du hast keine Berechtigung für die Verei: You don't have permission for the club accounting. Please contact an administrator.
translations.Das ist ein Beispielverein zum Ausprobie: This is a sample club for trying things out, not real data.
translations.Kontoauszug und Saldenliste prüfen (Tabs: Check account statements and trial balance (“Accounts” and “Reports” tabs)

translations.Ändern ist mit dieser Rolle nicht möglic: Changes are not possible with this role.

translations.Beispielverein angelegt – schau dich ger: Sample club created – feel free to look around. To start with real data: reset.

translations.Diese Buchung hat auf beiden Seiten mehr: This entry has several accounts on both sides – the app cannot edit an entry like this.
